What actually fired, and what didn\'t.

Your phone\'s manufacturer (Samsung, Xiaomi/MI, Motorola, etc.) tries to save battery by closing apps running in the background. This can stop Traffic Control from playing at the right time. Complete every step below once, on this phone, so alarms never get missed.
Needed to show that Traffic Control is running and to play sound reliably.
Stops stock Android from pausing this app to save battery.

Some phone brands (Xiaomi/MIUI in particular) block precise alarm timing unless this is granted separately, even though stock Android doesn\'t require it. Without this, alarms can be delayed or skipped entirely.

Android 14 and newer block apps from popping the ringing screen (with the Stop button and volume control) over the lock screen unless this is granted separately. Without it, the song still plays, but you won\'t see the Stop screen or be able to adjust volume with the hardware buttons until you unlock the phone yourself.

Most phone brands (Xiaomi, Samsung, Vivo, Oppo, Motorola, OnePlus…) have an EXTRA battery manager of their own, on top of Android\'s. Open it and allow Traffic Control to auto-start and run in the background.
Fires a test alarm one minute from now, using the real alarm path end-to-end, so you know immediately if setup worked — no need to wait until 3:30 AM.
